issues.location: Far right side of Shelf 3 and Shelf 4
issues.description: A hanging display with leopard print packaging (VELVET brand) partially obscures some Nivea products on Shelf 3 and Shelf 4, making them less visible.

model_reasoning: The shelves are generally well-stocked and organized with a high fill rate. Products are mostly aligned, and there are no significant empty spaces or damaged items. The primary issue identified is a hanging display on the far right that partially obstructs some products on the third and fourth shelves, which is a minor merchandising concern. All products are identifiable and prices are visible.
summary: zona Z_S6 com fill rate de 96%, detetados produtos de cuidado corporal e facial (loções corporais, cremes de mãos, cuidado facial, óleos especiais, mousses corporais e toalhitas). Um expositor suspenso da marca VELVET (com padrão leopardo) obscurece parcialmente produtos Nivea na secção direita das prateleiras 3 e 4, com severidade baixa. Quarta-feira 10 de junho de 2026 às 19h55, estado warning.
